count.description: The number of votes for this answer

me_voted.description: Whether the current user voted for this answer

Poll_Create.description: Request object to create a poll.

allow_multiselect.description: Whether a user can select multiple answers, defaults to false

answers.description: Each of the answers available in the poll, up to 10

duration.description: Number of hours the poll should be open for, up to 32 days, defaults to 24

layout_type.description: The layout type of the poll, defaults to 1

question.description: The question of the poll (only text is supported)

Poll_Media.description: The text or emoji of a poll question or answer.

is_finalized.description: Whether the votes have been precisely counted

Role.description: Represents a role in a guild.

color.description: description becomes "Deprecated, integer representation of hexadecimal color code (use colors)"

flags.description: Role flags combined as a bitfield

hoist.description: If this role is pinned in the user listing

managed.description: Whether this role is managed by an integration

primary_color.description: The primary color for the role

secondary_color.description: The secondary color for the role, makes the role a gradient

tertiary_color.description: The tertiary color for the role, turns the gradient into a holographic style

Role_Create.description: Request body for creating a guild role.

hoist.description: Whether the role should be displayed separately in the sidebar

icon.description: The role's icon image data URI (ROLE_ICONS feature)

mentionable.description: Whether the role should be mentionable

name.description: Name of the role, max 100 characters

permissions.description: Bitwise value of the enabled/disabled permissions

Role_Position.description: One entry of a modify guild role positions request.

available_for_purchase.description: Present (as null) if this role is available for purchase

bot_id.description: The id of the bot this role belongs to

guild_connections.description: Present (as null) if this role is a guild's linked role

integration_id.description: The id of the integration this role belongs to

premium_subscriber.description: Present (as null) if this is the guild's Booster role

subscription_listing_id.description: The id of this role's subscription sku and listing

Role_Update.description: Request body for modifying a guild role.

color.description: New deprecated RGB color value (use colors)

hoist.description: New value whether the role should be displayed separately in the sidebar

icon.description: New icon image data URI of the role (ROLE_ICONS feature)

mentionable.description: New value whether the role should be mentionable

name.description: New name of the role, max 100 characters

permissions.description: New bitwise value of the enabled/disabled permissions

unicode_emoji.description: New unicode emoji of the role (ROLE_ICONS feature)

Sticker.description: Represents a sticker that can be sent in messages.

available.description: Whether this guild sticker can be used

format_type.description: Type of sticker format (1 PNG, 2 APNG, 3 LOTTIE, 4 GIF)

guild_id.description: Id of the guild that owns this sticker

pack_id.description: For standard stickers, id of the pack the sticker is from

sort_value.description: The standard sticker's sort order within its pack

tags.description: Autocomplete/suggestion tags for the sticker (max 200 characters)

type.description: Type of sticker (1 STANDARD, 2 GUILD)

user.description: The user that uploaded the guild sticker

Sticker_Item.description: The smallest amount of data required to render a sticker.

Thread_Create.description: Request body for starting a thread without a message, or a thread in a forum/media channel (set message and applied_tags for forum/media).

applied_tags.description: The ids of the tags applied to the thread (forum/media channels only)

auto_archive_duration.description: Minutes of inactivity before auto archive (60, 1440, 4320, 10080)

invitable.description: Whether non-moderators can add other non-moderators to a private thread

message.description: Contents of the first message (forum/media channels only, required there)

rate_limit_per_user.description: Seconds a user has to wait before sending another message (0-21600)

type.description: The type of thread to create (10, 11 or 12; text channels only, defaults to PRIVATE_THREAD)

Thread_Create_From_Message.description: Request body for starting a thread from a message.

auto_archive_duration.description: Minutes of inactivity before auto archive (60, 1440, 4320, 10080)

rate_limit_per_user.description: Seconds a user has to wait before sending another message (0-21600)

Thread_Forum_Message.description: Contents of the first message of a forum or media thread.

components.description: Components to include with the message

flags.description: Message flags combined as a bitfield (SUPPRESS_EMBEDS and SUPPRESS_NOTIFICATIONS only)

sticker_ids.description: Ids of up to 3 stickers in the server to send in the message

Thread_List.description: A list of threads with the current user's thread members.

has_more.description: Whether there are potentially more threads (archived thread lists only)

members.description: A thread member object for each returned thread the current user has joined

Thread_Member.description: Information about a user that has joined a thread.

flags.description: User-thread settings, currently only used for notifications

join_timestamp.description: Time the user last joined the thread

member.description: Additional information about the user (only with with_member=true)

Thread_Metadata.description: Thread-specific fields not needed by other channels.

archive_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the thread's archive status was last changed

auto_archive_duration.description: Minutes of inactivity after which the thread stops showing in the channel list (60, 1440, 4320, 10080)

create_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the thread was created

invitable.description: Whether non-moderators can add other non-moderators to a private thread

accent_color.description: The user's banner color encoded as an integer representation of hexadecimal color code

bot.description: Whether the user belongs to an OAuth2 application

flags.description: The flags on a user's account

global_name.description: The user's display name, if it is set

mfa_enabled.description: Whether the user has two factor enabled on their account

premium_type.description: The type of Nitro subscription on a user's account

public_flags.description: The public flags on a user's account

system.description: Whether the user is an Official Discord System user

username.description: The user's username, not unique across the platform

verified.description: Whether the email on this account has been verified

User_DM_Create.description: Request body for creating a DM channel.

recipient_id.description: The recipient to open a DM channel with

User_Update.description: Request body for modifying the current user.

avatar.description: Image data URI, modifies the user's avatar

banner.description: Image data URI, modifies the user's banner

username.description: User's username, if changed may cause the user's discriminator to be randomized

Webhook.description: A webhook, a low-effort way to post messages to channels.

application_id.description: The bot/OAuth2 application that created this webhook

avatar.description: The default user avatar hash of the webhook

channel_id.description: The channel id this webhook is for, if any

guild_id.description: The guild id this webhook is for, if any

name.description: The default name of the webhook

source_channel.description: The channel that this webhook is following (Channel Follower webhooks)

source_guild.description: The guild of the channel that this webhook is following (Channel Follower webhooks)

token.description: The secure token of the webhook (Incoming webhooks)

type.description: The type of the webhook (1 Incoming, 2 Channel Follower, 3 Application)

url.description: The url used for executing the webhook (webhooks OAuth2 flow)

user.description: The user this webhook was created by (not returned when getting a webhook with its token)

Webhook_Create.description: Request body for creating a webhook.

avatar.description: Image data URI for the default webhook avatar

Webhook_Execute.description: Request body for executing a webhook or creating an interaction followup message.

applied_tags.description: Array of tag ids to apply to the thread (forum or media webhook channels only)

avatar_url.description: Override the default avatar of the webhook

components.description: The components to include with the message

embeds.description: Up to 10 embedded rich content objects

flags.description: Message flags combined as a bitfield (SUPPRESS_EMBEDS, SUPPRESS_NOTIFICATIONS, IS_COMPONENTS_V2; EPHEMERAL for interaction followups)

thread_name.description: Name of thread to create (forum or media webhook channels only)

tts.description: True if this is a TTS message

username.description: Override the default username of the webhook

Webhook_Message_Update.description: Request body for editing a webhook message or interaction response/followup.

attachments.description: Attached files to keep and their metadata

components.description: The components to include with the message

embeds.description: Up to 10 embedded rich content objects

flags.description: Message flags (SUPPRESS_EMBEDS and IS_COMPONENTS_V2 only)

poll.description: A poll (only when editing a deferred interaction response)

Webhook_Update.description: Request body for modifying a webhook.

avatar.description: Image data URI for the default webhook avatar

channel_id.description: The new channel id this webhook should be moved to

name.description: The default name of the webhook

ban.bulkCreate.description: Ban up to 200 users from a guild. Requires BAN_MEMBERS and MANAGE_GUILD.

ban.create.description: Create a guild ban, and optionally delete previous messages sent by the banned user. Requires BAN_MEMBERS.

ban.get.description: Returns a ban object for the given user. Requires BAN_MEMBERS.

ban.getAll.description: Returns a list of ban objects for the users banned from this guild. Requires BAN_MEMBERS.

ban.remove.description: Remove the ban for a user. Requires BAN_MEMBERS.

channel.createInvite.description: Create a new invite object for the channel. Only usable for guild channels.

channel.delete.description: Delete a channel, or close a private message.

channel.deletePermission.description: Delete a channel permission overwrite for a user or role in a channel.

channel.follow.description: Follow an announcement channel to send messages to a target channel.

channel.get.description: Get a channel by ID. Returns a channel object.

channel.getInvites.description: Returns a list of invite objects (with invite metadata) for the channel. Requires MANAGE_CHANNELS.

channel.getPins.description: Returns a paginated list of pinned messages in the channel, sorted by pinned_at descending.

channel.pinMessage.description: Pin a message in a channel. Requires the PIN_MESSAGES permission. Max 250 pinned messages.

channel.triggerTyping.description: Post a typing indicator for the specified channel, which expires after 10 seconds.

channel.unpinMessage.description: Unpin a message in a channel.

channel.update.description: Update a channel's settings. Returns a channel object on success.

channel.updatePermission.description: Edit the channel permission overwrites for a user or role in a channel.

command.bulkOverwriteGlobal.description: Overwrite all global commands of the application with the provided list.

command.bulkOverwriteGuild.description: Overwrite all guild commands of the application for the guild with the provided list.

command.createGlobal.description: Create a new global command. Returns 201 if created, or 200 if a command with the same name already existed and was overwritten.

command.createGuild.description: Create a new guild command. Returns 201 if created, or 200 if an existing command with the same name was overwritten.

command.getAllGlobal.description: Fetch all of the global commands for your application.

command.getAllGuild.description: Fetch all of the guild commands for your application for a specific guild.

command.getAllGuildPermissions.description: Fetches permissions for all commands for your application in a guild.

command.getGlobal.description: Fetch a global command for your application.

command.getGuild.description: Fetch a guild command for your application.

command.getPermissions.description: Fetches permissions for a specific command for your application in a guild.

command.updatePermissions.description: Edits command permissions for a specific command in a guild. Requires a Bearer token with the applications.commands.permissions.update scope (bot tokens are rejected).

gateway.get.description: Returns an object with a valid WSS URL for connecting to the Gateway.

gateway.getBot.description: Returns the gateway URL plus recommended shard count and session start limits for bots.

guild.beginPrune.description: Begin a prune operation. Requires MANAGE_GUILD and KICK_MEMBERS.

guild.createChannel.description: Create a new channel for the guild. Requires MANAGE_CHANNELS.

guild.get.description: Returns the guild object for the given id. If with_counts is true, approximate_member_count and approximate_presence_count are included.

guild.getActiveThreads.description: Returns all active threads in the guild, including public and private threads, ordered by id descending.

guild.getAuditLog.description: Returns an audit log object for the guild. Requires VIEW_AUDIT_LOG.

guild.getChannels.description: Returns a list of guild channel objects.

guild.getInvites.description: Returns a list of invite objects (with invite metadata) for the guild. Requires MANAGE_GUILD or VIEW_AUDIT_LOG.

guild.getMembers.description: Returns a list of guild member objects that are members of the guild.

guild.getPruneCount.description: Returns the number of members that would be removed in a prune operation. Requires MANAGE_GUILD and KICK_MEMBERS.

guild.getRoles.description: Returns a list of role objects for the guild.

guild.update.description: Modify a guild's settings. Requires MANAGE_GUILD.

guild.updateChannelPositions.description: Modify the positions of a set of channels in the guild. Requires MANAGE_CHANNELS.

interaction.createFollowup.description: Create a followup message for an interaction. Set flags to 64 (EPHEMERAL) for an ephemeral message; username, avatar_url, thread_name and applied_tags are ignored.

interaction.createResponse.description: Create a response to an interaction from the gateway. Must be sent within 3 seconds of receiving the interaction.

interaction.deleteFollowup.description: Deletes a followup message for an interaction.

interaction.getFollowup.description: Returns a followup message for an interaction.

interaction.updateFollowup.description: Edits a followup message for an interaction.

invite.delete.description: Delete an invite. Requires MANAGE_CHANNELS on the channel or MANAGE_GUILD. Returns the deleted invite.

invite.get.description: Returns an invite object for the given code.

member.add.description: Adds a user to the guild using an OAuth2 access token with the guilds.join scope. Returns 201 with the member, or 204 if the user is already a member.

member.addRole.description: Adds a role to a guild member. Requires MANAGE_ROLES.

member.get.description: Returns a guild member object for the specified user.

member.remove.description: Remove (kick) a member from a guild. Requires KICK_MEMBERS.

member.removeRole.description: Removes a role from a guild member. Requires MANAGE_ROLES.

member.search.description: Returns a list of guild members whose username or nickname starts with the provided string.

member.update.description: Modify attributes of a guild member (nick, roles, voice state, timeout).

member.updateCurrent.description: Modifies the current member in a guild.

message.addReaction.description: Create a reaction for the message with the specified emoji.

message.bulkDelete.description: Delete 2-100 messages in a single request. Messages older than 2 weeks cannot be deleted.

message.create.description: Post a message to a guild text or DM channel.

message.crosspost.description: Crosspost a message in an Announcement Channel to following channels.

message.deleteAllReactions.description: Deletes all reactions on a message.

message.deleteAllReactionsForEmoji.description: Deletes all the reactions for a given emoji on a message. Requires MANAGE_MESSAGES.

message.deleteOwnReaction.description: Delete a reaction the current user has made for the specified emoji.

message.deleteUserReaction.description: Deletes another user's reaction. Requires MANAGE_MESSAGES.

message.get.description: Retrieves a specific message in the channel.

message.getAll.description: Retrieves the messages in a channel.

message.getReactionsByEmoji.description: Get a list of users that reacted with the specified emoji.

role.create.description: Create a new role for the guild. Requires MANAGE_ROLES.

role.delete.description: Delete a guild role. Requires MANAGE_ROLES.

role.get.description: Returns a role object for the specified role.

role.update.description: Modify a guild role. Requires MANAGE_ROLES.

role.updatePositions.description: Modify the positions of a set of roles. Returns all of the guild's roles.

thread.addMember.description: Adds another member to a thread.

thread.getJoinedPrivateArchived.description: Returns archived private threads in the channel that the current user has joined.

thread.getMember.description: Returns a thread member object for the specified user if they are a member of the thread.

thread.getMembers.description: Returns the thread members of the thread. Requires the GUILD_MEMBERS privileged intent.

thread.getPrivateArchived.description: Returns archived private threads in the channel. Requires READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY and MANAGE_THREADS.

thread.getPublicArchived.description: Returns archived public threads in the channel, ordered by archive_timestamp descending.

thread.join.description: Adds the current user to a thread.

thread.leave.description: Removes the current user from a thread.

thread.removeMember.description: Removes another member from a thread.

thread.start.description: Creates a new thread that is not connected to an existing message. In forum or media channels set message (required) and applied_tags; the returned channel then includes the nested message.

thread.startFromMessage.description: Creates a new thread from an existing message.

user.createDm.description: Create a new DM channel with a user. Returns the existing DM channel if one exists.

user.get.description: Returns a user object for a given user ID.

user.getCurrent.description: Returns the user object of the requester's account.

user.getCurrentGuildMember.description: Returns a guild member object for the current user (requires the guilds.members.read OAuth2 scope).

user.getGuilds.description: Returns a list of partial guild objects the current user is a member of.

user.update.description: Modify the current user's account settings.

webhook.create.description: Creates a new webhook. Requires MANAGE_WEBHOOKS.

webhook.delete.description: Delete a webhook permanently. Requires MANAGE_WEBHOOKS.

webhook.deleteMessage.description: Deletes a message that was created by the webhook.

webhook.execute.description: Execute a webhook. Set wait=true to receive the created message (otherwise Discord answers 204 with no body).

webhook.get.description: Returns the webhook object for the given id.

webhook.getAllByChannel.description: Returns a list of channel webhook objects. Requires MANAGE_WEBHOOKS.

webhook.getAllByGuild.description: Returns a list of guild webhook objects. Requires MANAGE_WEBHOOKS.

webhook.getMessage.description: Returns a previously-sent webhook message from the same token.

webhook.getWithToken.description: Returns the webhook object for the given id and token (no user object, no authentication required).

webhook.updateMessage.description: Edits a previously-sent webhook message from the same token.
